tests.description: The contract between manni meta and a pipeline, exercised against the local build.

steps.description: Exit 0: every validated file satisfies its schema set.
Exit 1: one or more files failed validation.
Exit 2: an unknown flag is a usage error, not a validation failure.
Exit 2: a missing required argument is a usage error.
Exit 2: get with no field list is an operational error, not an empty report.
github annotation line carries file= and line= for an error with a known line.
get has no github output: it reports values, not findings (exit 2).

runShell.command: manni meta get type test/fixtures/valid.md --format github

steps.description: fill does accept github, for the required properties it could not fill. --provider mock --dry-run keeps this away from a real provider and from writing to the fixture.

runShell.command: manni meta fill test/fixtures/valid.md --format github --provider mock --dry-run --no-cache

steps.description: junit stays validate-only on fill (exit 2), and so does sarif.

runShell.command: manni meta fill test/fixtures/valid.md --format junit --provider mock --dry-run --no-cache
